items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] John You, or Yo? [INTERVIEWEE] John You – Y-o-u – who is the chief theoretician of the Bush administration.

ctx.x: Yeah, I’m the oldest survivor, because I started – I’ll be at my fiftieth anniversary, I think, next year. I don’t think I’ll get a gold watch, but I hope I’ve still got the check. The Journal is a very interesting paper, because there is a separation of church and state there that’s very impressive. When I first came to New York I got to know some Journal reporters. They’d say, “Look. Whatever they say on the editorial page doesn’t effect what we do as reporters,” and that’s still the same. The so-called…
John You – Y-o-u – who is the chief theoretician of the Bush administration.
